scenes.vo: Seventy one percent of British workers use AI their employer never approved. Two in three requests rework text people paste in: contracts, payslips, client letters. Every name in them rides out to the model provider.

scenes.label: What is MuGuard
scenes.vo: MuGuard keeps them inside the walls. It hides personal data before any AI sees it, and the hiding is done by a small model we trained on Mubit.

scenes.title: Three developers, three ways to train
scenes.vo: Mubit records our calls to a big teacher model, and trains a small one to copy it. We trained ours three ways. Mykola used a hundred and eighty realistic documents. Glib, five hundred and seventy six synthetic cases. Dmytro, a hundred thousand generated ones, with the cheapest teacher.
scenes.source: data/docs, data/review_redaction_v2, datagen; teachers from each account's run logs

scenes.title: Same student, three teachers
scenes.vo: Mubit then tests each one on calls it never trained on. Only Mykola's cleared the eighty five percent bar, at ninety one point seven. Realism beat volume, so MuGuard runs on his design.
scenes.note: Mubit quality: the share of its own teacher's answers each adapter matched on held-out test cases. Data, format and teacher all differ and the tests are small, so read it as a signal.

scenes.label: Quest 1: Drop a document
scenes.vo: Now the demo. I drop in a tenancy agreement, and the knight reads it part by part, with rules for UK numbers.

scenes.label: Quest 2: Review
scenes.vo: Seconds later, every name, address and number is struck out, and truly removed from the PDF.

scenes.label: Every part is a Mubit call
scenes.vo: Each part is its own Mubit call, with its request id.

scenes.label: Quest 3: Fix a miss
scenes.vo: Missed one? The landlord is our client, so I mark the name and hide it. Mubit trains the next version of the model on exactly that correction.

scenes.label: Quest 4: Approve
scenes.vo: Only once I approve may the document pass the gate.

scenes.label: Quest 5: Ask the AI
scenes.vo: Now I ask when the landlord may raise the rent. Claude sees only placeholders, and MuGuard restores the true names on my own machine.

scenes.label: What the AI received
scenes.vo: This is all the AI ever received. No names. No addresses. No account numbers.
